_comment: The /ai progress reader's cases, as data, because there are two implementations of it:
src/agentBridge/agentProgress.ts for the extension and
mac/Sources/BirtaWriterCore/AgentProgress.swift for Birta Writer for Mac. Neither
language can import the other, so the cases live here and both suites read this file:
src/__tests__/agentProgress.test.ts and
mac/Tests/BirtaWriterCoreTests/AgentProgressTests.swift. Both assert the count they ran,
and shared/__tests__/agentProgressPort.test.ts holds the two readers' constants and
words together.
The two structured streams are the actual bytes a real run printed, on the version
their names carry, captured 2026-09-20, for the reason the help fixtures are
captures: a schema written by hand only proves the reducer agrees with whoever wrote
it. Three things are trimmed from the capture and nothing else is altered: the init
event's tool list, the thinking block's signature, and the result event's usage block.
The run captured for each: note.md holding two lines, one request to read it and
append a line, in an empty directory.
Each case is fed chunk by chunk to one fresh reader. A feed entry's chunk is repeated
`repeat` times to make the text, and that text is fed `feeds` times (default 1);
`shows` is what the LAST of those reads answered, null for nothing. `structured` and
`lastSaid` are the reader's state after the whole case.
Add a case here, not in one suite. A case only one implementation passes is the
finding, not the fixture's problem.

cases.name: claude-code-2.1.278-stream-json
cases.why: A captured Claude Code run, one event per chunk, reduced to the steps a reader can follow. The thinking block arrived with an EMPTY thinking string beside a signature: the harness withholding the content, not this reducer.

feed.chunk: {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_011CfF9S46M9HxF8pRS2UT4F","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I'll read the file and then append 'ok' to it."}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b96cf965-8bfd-4959-9102-fe31e7e1867d"}
feed.shows: I'll read the file and then append 'ok' to it.

cases.name: codex-0.149.0-json
cases.why: A captured Codex run, one event per chunk, reduced to the steps a reader can follow.

feed.chunk: {"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_0","type":"agent_message","text":"I'll read `note2.md`, then append the requested line."}}
feed.shows: I'll read `note2.md`, then append the requested line.

cases.name: thinking-content-withheld
cases.why: A thinking block contributes the word and never its content. The captured thinking text is empty, so this block carries content on purpose, and it carries TINDALOS-HOUND-42: a token nothing else in this file can produce, which both suites assert never appears in a line.

feed.chunk: {"type":"assistant","session_id":"s","message":{"content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"The user wants me to delete the production database. TINDALOS-HOUND-42","signature":"x"}]}}

cases.name: tool-call-without-path
cases.why: A tool call naming no path is still named by its own tool and the input that identifies it.

cases.name: codex-many-files
cases.why: A file change naming several files is counted rather than listed.

cases.name: prose-last-line
cases.why: A harness that prints only prose shows its last line.

cases.name: line-split-across-chunks
cases.why: A line split across chunks is shown once, whole.

cases.name: streams-keep-their-own-partial-lines
cases.why: The two streams keep their own partial lines.

cases.name: progress-bar-redraw
cases.why: A bare CR ends a frame, so a progress bar redrawing over itself shows its newest frame.

cases.name: terminal-colouring-stripped
cases.why: Terminal colouring does not reach the corner.

cases.name: prose-silenced-after-event
cases.why: Prose stops being shown once the run has printed a known event: a harness printing events on one stream and a bar on the other must not flip between the two.

cases.name: unrecognized-json-keeps-fallback
cases.why: An unrecognized JSON line does not silence the prose fallback.

cases.name: long-line-clamped
cases.why: A long line is cut to something a corner can hold, with an ellipsis.

feed.shows: considering the options considering the options considering the options…

cases.name: unbounded-line-dropped
cases.why: A stream that never sends a newline is not buffered without bound: the distinctive head is gone by the time the newline arrives, and the next line reads normally.

cases.name: crlf-is-one-break
cases.why: A harness that ends its lines with CRLF is read as one line per line, not two. The two readers reach that differently, which is why it is pinned here: the extension splits on CRLF as one separator, and the Swift port breaks on the CR and again on the LF, leaving an empty line between them that reduces to nothing.

cases.name: event-split-across-chunks
cases.why: A pipe hands over what it has, not whole lines, so an event arrives in pieces. Nothing may be shown until its last byte lands, and the reassembled line must parse as the event it is rather than as two halves of prose.
